layman_headline: Fear grips the crypto market — patience is the best trade right now.
layman_explanation: The overall crypto market is in a fearful state with Bitcoin dropping below $63K and altcoins bleeding even harder. None of the swing candidates present a compelling risk-reward setup today. The strongest-performing coins (AKE, VELVET) are wildly overbought after 100%+ runs, while the beaten-down ones (BEAT, UNI) lack clear bottoming signals or catalysts. Solana is the most interesting larger-cap name showing relative strength (+2.6% weekly vs BTC's -3%), but it still doesn't have enough technical confirmation to justify an entry right now.
layman_action: Stay in cash and wait. Set price alerts for Solana around $72-73 and UNI around $2.90. A better entry will come when fear peaks and we see a real capitulation flush or a clear reversal signal.
expert_reasoning: The Fear & Greed index has been stuck at 29 for multiple days with a worsening trend — this suggests we haven't seen peak fear yet. BTC dominance at 56.1% is pressuring alts, and the weekly BTC chart warns of further downside per CoinTelegraph. The swing candidates are polarized: AKE (RSI 79) and VELVET (+94% weekly) are chasing extended moves with no clear support levels, while BEAT's -68% weekly crash screams knife-catching risk with no RSI confirmation of oversold conditions. UNI at -18% weekly is interesting but lacks RSI data and any positive catalyst. SOL is the best risk-adjusted candidate but needs to pull back to the $72-73 support zone before entry makes sense. Discipline demands we wait for a higher-conviction setup.
risk_factors: BTC weekly close below $62K could trigger accelerated alt selling and invalidate any near-term long thesis
Fear & Greed worsening trend suggests market hasn't bottomed — premature entries get punished
High BTC dominance (56.1%) means capital is rotating out of alts, creating persistent headwinds for alt swing trades
watch_list: BTC weekly close level — a close below $62K would signal further downside and delay any entries
SOL price action near $72-73 support zone — a bounce there with rising volume would trigger a BUY signal
Fear & Greed index — watch for a drop to 20 or below which historically marks capitulation bottoms
market_context: The crypto market is in a fear-driven correction with BTC sliding below $63K despite bullish institutional signals (JPMorgan and Morgan Stanley increasing ETF positions). The disconnect between institutional positioning and spot price weakness suggests more near-term downside before a resolution higher.
context_banner: Market fear is worsening with no clear bottom signal — capital preservation is the highest-conviction play until the selling exhausts itself.

key_signals.description: Fear & Greed stuck at 29 with worsening trend for multiple days — historically this precedes either capitulation or slow bleed, neither favors new entries.
Bitcoin price warning of further losses on weekly close below current levels, reinforcing the case for patience.
Bitcoin ETF call options surged 24x while puts fell 53% — smart money is positioning for a bounce but timing remains uncertain.
AKE at RSI 79 is overbought (reliable signal per track record at 71% win rate) — confirms avoiding longs on extended names. BEAT at RSI 51 is neutral, not yet oversold enough for a bounce play.
Israel's largest bank partnering with Galaxy to offer BTC/ETH/SOL trading — a structural positive for SOL but not enough to override bearish market conditions.
